title: 电商欺骗性界面下的Web智能体安全基准测试
summary: 提出了WebDecept框架，用于在电商环境中注入七种常见欺骗性界面模式，评估多模态Web智能体的安全性。结果表明当前智能体极易受骗，基于提示的约束不足以缓解风险，揭示了实际部署中的安全挑战。
summary_en: Introduces WebDecept, a plugin framework for injecting deceptive interface patterns into e-commerce environments to evaluate web agent safety. Results show current agents are highly susceptible and prompt-based constraints are insufficient, highlighting safety challenges for real-world deployment.
